meta.description: API latency baselines for core ApexMail API endpoints. These values represent the expected end-to-end latency for the API server under normal load (100 concurrent users, standard CI runner).

auth_login.description: End-to-end latency for POST /v1/auth/login. Includes credential validation, session creation, and JWT generation.

email_send.description: End-to-end latency for POST /v1/email/send. Includes payload validation, spam scanning, queue submission, and response.

health_liveness.description: Latency for GET /v1/health/liveness. Lightweight check — no database query, in-process only.

health_readiness.description: Latency for GET /v1/health/readiness. Includes database connectivity check and cache health probe.

api_overall.description: Aggregate latency across all API endpoints in the combined journey test. Reflects the weighted average of auth, email, and health endpoints.
